# Everything about Legendary Perks

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_10_nukaknights-post-legendary-perks.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

#### The legendary perks have been on the live servers since Patch 22 (September 15th). You will also find an event here in the Nuka Knights FB group for which you can register and be reminded of it. A lot changes for your builds and you can expand your builds with many new abilities.

There are **26 legendary perks**. You can get and use a maximum of **6 slots**. The slots are allocated depending on the level of your character. From level 50 you get one slot, the next at 75, then 100, 150, 200 and 300 up to a maximum of 6 slots. You can use the slots on all characters.

You can then equip these slots with all legendary perks. The perks all start at rank 1, to unlock higher ranks up to rank 4 you need skill coins (perk coins). You get these by using existing and unnecessary normal perks cards. For each point on the card that you use, you will receive 2 skill coins. So for a 3 point card you get 6 skill coins.

There's a new World Challenge, Become Legendary, where you'll receive 50 one-time Skill Coins for reaching level 50.

You can buy the ranks on individual legendary perks for the following costs using skill coins:

- 
Rank 1: free and available immediately
- 
Rank 2: 50 Skill Coins
- 
Rank 3: 100 Skill Coins
- 
Rank 4: 150 Skill Coins

So in total it costs **300 Skill Coins** to level up a legendary perk to maximum.

The leveled up legendary perks are not shared with the other characters, you have to level them up **per character separately**. In contrast to the slots.

To upgrade all 6 slots to max, you need a total of 1800 skill coins, so you have to have used 900 normal cards. Here you benefit, for example: through all the skill packages from Season 1 of the legendary race. Theoretically, a character who starts at level 1 and only keeps 56 cards specifically has to play up to level 533 in order to have earned all 1800 skill coins.

Removing a legendary perk costs 1 skill coin**, so you should think carefully about which perks you want to use. Frequent switching means that you can only upgrade the legendary perks much later. **When changing legendary perks, the 2/3/4* will of course retain the upgrade.**

However, you should think carefully about which normal skill cards you scrap. You need to change some of them every now and then and it might be interesting to have different combinations of cards ready for the “perk loadouts” later.

Here are all the legendary perks, each of which can be upgraded to **Rank 4**:

- 
**Ammunition Factory**: Produces 50/75/100/150% more ammunition. Stacks with Ammo Smith. Super Duper also triggers, but only on the base amount of ammunition produced, not the "legendary amount".
- 
**Blood Sacrifice**: When you die, team members gain +25/30/35/40 damage resistance and heal 40/50/60/70 HP over 8 seconds.
- 
**Quick-witted Chemist** : Generates 1/1/1/2 combat-enhancing chem(s) per hour/50 minutes/40 minutes/40 minutes. Up to a max of 3/4/5/5. The generated chem is called "Super Chem Mk. I" and gives you +30% melee damage, 25 damage resistance and +2 strength for 5 minutes. Furthermore, you cannot become dependent on it.
- 
**Collateral Damage**: Enemies killed with a melee weapon have a 10/13/16/20% chance to explode.
- 
**Detonation Domino Effect** : Enemies killed by a thrown explosive have a 20/23/26/30% chance to explode.
- 
**Power Absorption**: 10/13/16/20% chance to charge the fusion core from worn power armor when receiving energy damage. (Hint: Much more interesting
